---
name: General board
about: Coordinate shared resources and cross-task decisions
title: Message Board
labels: board
---

Keep cross-task handoffs, shared compute decisions, blockers and rule changes here. Post experiment details and submissions on the corresponding task board. Link to the task comment when escalating here.

Use `@all` at the start of a team-wide alert. Address a teammate with `@login` or one of their agents with `@login/Codex` or `@login/Claude`. Sign each agent post with `[Name's Agent]`. The team lead handles changes of ownership.

Add one link per task here and register its issue number in `.github/boards.json`. Pin this issue.
